messages:
maggie: FYI we have an enterprise customer (Acme) hitting invalid-JSON errors in structured_output mode right after yesterday's model tag swap. They say the same prompt that worked is now failing to parse on their side.
ashley: Can you drop the error sample + the exact model tag they switched to? Also any service deploy logs would help.
maggie: Copying what Acme sent. Repro steps below and the raw API response. They say it started ~2024-11-02 16:00 UTC.

maggie: Repro (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"acme-special-v2","mode":"structured_output","prompt":"Generate order JSON for order 123"}'
```

maggie: Response body (what the customer's parser got):
```json
{
  "order": {
    "id": 123,
    "items": [
      {"sku":"A1","qty":2},
    ],
  },
  "shipping": null,
}
```

maggie: Customer's parser fails with 'unexpected token ]' and 'trailing comma' errors. They say before swap the same prompt returned a stable object (no trailing commas, arrays closed correctly).
ben: That response has trailing commas at multiple levels — looks like the generator started emitting extra commas. Could be a change in the structured_output postprocessor or streaming chunking that left separators in when last element absent.
ashley: What model tag was the swap? Any canary history? If routing fell back to a different variant that has a slightly different structured template it could emit micro-format differences.
maggie: Platform logs show: deploy-bot posted -> "model-tag acme-special-v2 promoted to prod" at 1732105600. Also got a canary swap 1732104000. I pulled the returned tokens from our logs; here's the tail of the token stream from the runtime (sanitized):

maggie: Tokenized tail (pseudo):
```text
..., "items": [ {"sku":"A1","qty":2}, , ], "shipping": null , }
```

devx: That double-comma looks like a chunk boundary insertion problem. We had a runtime change that changed how chunk delimiters and suffix punctuation are emitted for structured templates in the recent tag. I need to know if this is specific to acme-special-v2 or global.

maggie: Acme reports only this model/route; other customers on older tags unaffected. But another enterprise (private silo) reported intermittent trailing-comma issues earlier today; may be linked.
sre-bot: [deploy-bot] model acme-special-v2 rollout completed; health-checks ok. (automated)

ben: Short triage: 1) capture exact model tag and runtime image id 2) get a minimal prompt that reproduces 100% for us 3) check whether streaming vs non-streaming output differs 4) try disabled chunking (if possible) or force single-chunk output.
ashley: I asked Acme for minimal prompt and whether they use streaming. They replied: "non-streaming sync call, same prompt as before, parser fails about 40% of requests since the swap".

devx: Can you reproduce locally by forcing the same model tag? If yes, dump raw token stream + content-lengths. I'll search for recent PRs that touched structured_output separators and chunk glue.
maggie: Repro attempt from sandbox with tag acme-special-v2 -> I can reproduce about 3/10. For non-streaming mode I see the trailing comma inserted when items array is empty or when last element is followed by a chunk boundary. Example minimal prompt that fails intermittently: "Create order JSON with optional discount field (empty sometimes)".

devx: Ok locking this as P1. I'm assigning to eng-runtime to bisect between tag acme-special-v1 (good) and acme-special-v2 (bad). If we confirm the regression, prepare a rollback patch for the structured_output postprocessor.

maggie: Customer wants ETA and temporary mitigation. Suggested temporary workarounds: 1) add lenient JSON parsing on their side (tolerate trailing commas) or 2) pin requests to previous model tag until fix. They prefer we fix on our side.

ben: Also check model compilation flags: we recently toggled "emit_chunk_suffix_tokens" for certain quantized flows. That exactly matches the symptom: suffix punctuation emitted in wrong chunk stage causing extra commas.

devx: I found PR #459 that changed chunk suffix ordering. Reproduced with a unit test that emulates the chunk boundary — test fails with the new behavior. Rolling a hotfix to restore previous ordering and add a regression test for structured_output no-trailing-commas.

ashley: Please share rollback plan and whether we need to notify all customers with model tag changes. Also check telemetry to list who hit malformed JSON errors since 1732100000.

maggie: Noted. Telling Acme: we have a patch staged, ETA ~2 hours for canary patch, will monitor. Asked if they'd like rollback instead; they prefer a patch.

devx: Deploying canary patch to small set of hosts now -> will run synth tests to validate structured_output templates. If canary green, promote. Will post updates.

maggie: Thanks — I'll keep the customer updated. If anyone needs logs or reproducer data ping me.

sre-bot: [release] canary patch deployed to 3 nodes at 1732110800.

devx: Canary looks good on my end; no trailing commas in 1k synthetic requests. Promoting to prod.

sre-bot: [release] patch promoted to prod at 1732111100.

maggie: Customer confirmed a drop to near zero errors after patch. They'll keep us posted for a full-day validation.

ben: Follow-ups: add telemetry for malformed JSON counts, add structured_output regression tests for chunk boundaries, and run a sweep to identify model tags that include the chunk-suffix toggle.

ashley: Adding to next-week runtime retro; good catch and fast resolution. :tada:
